title: Lutut Bunyi Krek
subject: a thirty-one-year-old man in Bekasi whose left knee cracks loudly every time he stands up, so he can never sneak out of a boring meeting, a sleeping baby's room or a cinema without everyone turning to look
caption: Indonesian stoner rock, heavy groove-driven riff rock. Down-tuned fuzz guitar playing mid-tempo chugging riffs with wide bends, thick fuzz bass doubling the riff, big roomy drums with open crash and heavy tom fills, a growling Hammond-style organ in the choruses. Live-room recording, saturated and loud, slight tape warmth. Gritty male mid-low vocal, half-shouted and swaggering, with a wink. 126 BPM, E minor. Mood of a self-mocking riff party. No pop-punk, no metalcore screams, no autotune, no trap drums, no synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar riff, heavy drums]
[Verse 1]
Rapat jam tiga belum selesai
Aku mau kabur pelan-pelan
Kursi kugeser, napas kutahan
Tapi lututku lebih dulu bicara
[Pre-Chorus]
Semua kepala menoleh ke aku
Bos angkat alis, aku duduk lagi
[Chorus]
Krek! Lututku bunyi krek!
Umur tiga satu, suara kayak kakek
Krek! Mau kabur pun gagal
Lututku tukang lapor paling andal
[Verse 2]
Bayi kakakku baru tertidur
Aku jinjit keluar dari kamar
Satu langkah, dua langkah aman
Krek! Dia nangis sampai subuh
[Chorus]
Krek! Lututku bunyi krek!
Di bioskop pun orang ikut kaget
Krek! Mau kabur pun gagal
Sekarang aku minum susu kalsium
[Outro - organ swell, riff slows down]
Ya sudah, aku duduk saja
Krek
